description: This file defines the LogWrapper class, which implements the LogNode interface to wrap Android's native Log utility. It facilitates logging with additional chaining capabilities via linked LogNode objects, providing a customizable logging pipeline within an Android project.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class that wraps Android's native Log utility and implements logging with a linked chain of LogNodes.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode to which logs will be passed after this node.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs the message using Android's Log.println method and propagates the log to the next node in the chain if present.
